plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, discusses Bluegill Triple Prime, a US project from 1962 and 1963. Citing a paper from the RAND Corporation, a government-funded research group, and someone named Malmgren, he suggests it was an early form of an X-ray shield against missiles, a forerunner of the Strategic Defense Initiative, the later US plan to defend against nuclear missiles from space. If true, it would mean that kind of defence was being tried decades earlier than people think.
